They might be better for other gold filters that are not genuine Keurig, but they are not a good fit for the genuine single serve Keurig filter. I can see that they might not work so well if there is a significant height difference. They work best for me with the larger edge on the countertop.  Didn't want to cover up my new countertops with this not so attractive silicone strip, but when the red sauce I spilled wiped right off the strip I decided these were a necessity!

This silicone gap filler is a great lttle tool for solving what could be a nuisance.  Two strips came in the package- using one now, saving one for later or for another use if one arises.  I am using it to fill a space between my kitchen countertop and my electric range.  It merely sits on top to block moisture, crumbs, and other debris from falling into the gap.  It's a T-shape, so the fit is fairly snug. It makes cleanup quicker and easier because I don't have to worry about getting down between the sink and the range.  The look of the gap filler is nice.  The clear version does not appear to be there unless you stand close to it, so that makes the appearance nicer in my kitchen than colored ones that I tested (white and gray - I have a marble-tone white and gray countertop.)  Installation is simple.  Just measure, cut if necessary (so easy to do) and drop in place.  A useful, practical product that doesn't detract from the overall look of the kitchen.
I use these all the time and are buying more for other people.  They really do cover the gap.

This flexible nylon/silicone strip easily installed between the stove and the adjoining counters making spills easily contained and cleaned from "above" and not becoming a real problem dripping down the side of the stove, where it is not easy to clean.  Easy to wipe clean while in place or you have easily remove them (I have one on both sides of the stove) and wash in the sink.
Works well and just the ticket to protect the gap.

I was happy that it was as flexible as it was, and I think it will work better then I had anticipated.  All the pictures look like it’s raised, but it actually does sit flat.  We will see.

I bought these months ago, and stashed them away and forgot about them.  They come well wrapped but folded and when I found them I was afraid they'd be warped.  At first one seemed to fit better than the other.  Then I realized you have to press into the vertical side so it really adheres to the surface (in this case my stovetop). Then press hard into the crease from one end of the counter to the other.  Then trim outside edge as needed.  I have a sharp beveled edge on my counter and I'm on the fence as to where the end trim should be to look best. Also, . I am still debating whether I will trim the wider side to 1" so that it isn't so prominent on my countertop because it's a cloudy "clear" strip. See photos.  Those factors aside, I am very satisfied with this product.
